item.title: Pick a Card: 15 Questions to Reflect On Before the New Year
item.dc:creator: Margaret Cole
item.description: A December reflection in five cards. Pick one and see what it asks.
item.content:encoded:
December is almost here, and it makes everyone either very busy or very reflective. I’m trying for the second one, without the pressure.

So I made you a little deck, and you can play it right here.

How it works: each round, you’ll see five cards, face down. Pick the one you’re drawn to, don’t overthink it, and remember its color. Then find out what it says. Answer it out loud, in your notes app, or not at all.

Round one: Light

Easy ones. Go with your gut.

Cream: What was the best movie or TV show you watched this year?

Rose: What’s the best thing you ate this year?

Sand: What song was the soundtrack to your year?

Tan: Which day this year would you relive?

Stone: What’s a purchase you’re glad you made?

Round two: Medium

A little more honest.

Dove: What are you proud of that nobody noticed?

Clay: What did you say no to that you’re glad about?

Mocha: What’s something you’re finally letting go of?

Taupe: What did you do this year that past you would be surprised by?

Espresso: What’s one habit you developed that you love?

Round three: Deeper

Take your time with these.

Burgundy: What do you want more of next year?

Rust: What do you want less of next year?

Cocoa: What are you still carrying that you could put down?

Walnut: When did you feel most like yourself this year?

Ebony: What would need to happen for December to be a “successful” month?

If one of them stuck with you, write it down somewhere you’ll see it this month.

Comment what color you picked and what your answer was.

Want to flip the cards yourself, and keep the ones you want to write about? Play the interactive version on vitalityritual.org.
